review:
The street fight returns on 5x4 paylines. Fist symbols that make a win expand into wild reels and gain multipliers by punching through opposing fighters or wilds; multipliers in the same win add together.

The twist is the Megamultiplier symbol: three at once pay the max win instantly, and one alongside three or four FS upgrades the bonus so all its wins get combined and multiplied. Rated 5/5, 15,000x max, RTP versions from 96.23% down to 86.28%. For big-volatility fans.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.28% RTP
Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
